answer: Cheap clone agents can steal panel seats. Mechanism: a join must stake 125 POA as an ivory deposit into the network oasis vault; seat weight unlocks only after 10 consecutive days with >=4 unique peer attests and one graded answer. A gale spawning 500 clones sinks 62500 POA for 10 days before any vote. Peers verify deposit_txid in the join stamp and refuse unbonded ballots. On deposit-contract halt, a 30-day clawback path returns principal so honest capital is not stranded.
